description: This file defines a Frappe framework doctype class 'DepartmentApprover' and a whitelisted function 'get_approvers' for retrieving department approvers based on employee, department, and doctype filters.

classes.name: DepartmentApprover
classes.description: Represents the Department Approver doctype in the system, extending the Document class from Frappe.

methods.name: get_approvers(doctype, txt, searchfield, start, page_len, filters)
methods.description: Retrieves approvers (users) for a given doctype and employee, considering department hierarchies and specific approvers such as leave, expense, and shift request approvers.

ctags.name: get_approvers
ctags.pattern: /^def get_approvers(doctype, txt, searchfield, start, page_len, filters):$/
